The structure of LiTi2Mn2O6 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula Li4Ti8Mn8O24 and 44 atoms across 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Li centers as octahedral, coordinated by six O neighbors, while Mn and Ti each adopt tetrahedral coordination by four O neighbors. O centers show five geometric neighbors, comprising a mix of Li, Mn, and Ti. Corner-sharing is observed between Li octahedra and Mn/Ti tetrahedra, and between Mn and Ti tetrahedra, with Li octahedra also sharing edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 44 sites.
